To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the EM algorithm is a useful tool for training a mixture of experts; (ii) the EM algorithm can be used for training a mixture-of-experts network without having to select a learning rate; (iii) a mixture of experts trained by EM can learn a piecewise nonlinear function with fewer hidden units than a standard multilayer perceptron; (iv) a mixture of previously trained classifiers can be trained by EM to improve classification accuracy.
